Name: Install System Dependencies
Args: sudo yum update -y && sudo yum install -y git python3-pip python3-devel gcc gcc-c++ make unzip && sudo pip3 install --upgrade pip --force-reinstall --no-deps

Name: Create Repository Structure
Args: sudo mkdir -p /mnt/destark && sudo chown -R hadoop:hadoop /mnt/destark && cd /mnt/destark && mkdir -p app scripts logs data && echo 'Repository structure created' && pwd && ls -la

Name: Create Requirements Files
Args: cd /mnt/destark && echo 'numpy' > requirements-emr.txt && echo 'pandas' >> requirements-emr.txt && echo 'scikit-learn' >> requirements-emr.txt && echo 'matplotlib' >> requirements-emr.txt && echo 'seaborn' >> requirements-emr.txt && echo 'pyspark' > requirements-spark.txt && echo 'boto3' >> requirements-spark.txt && cat requirements-emr.txt && cat requirements-spark.txt

Name: Install Python Dependencies
Args: cd /mnt/destark && pip3 install -r requirements-emr.txt && pip3 install -r requirements-spark.txt && echo 'Python dependencies installed successfully'

Name: Create Simple FIS Script
Args: cd /mnt/destark && echo '#!/bin/bash' > scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh && echo 'echo "Starting FIS models..."' >> scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh && echo 'python3 -c "import numpy as np; print(\"FIS Models Test - NumPy version:\", np.__version__)"' >> scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh && echo 'echo "FIS models completed successfully!"' >> scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh && chmod +x scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh && cat scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh

Name: Run FIS Models Test
Args: cd /mnt/destark && mkdir -p logs && ./scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh 2>&1 | tee logs/emr_run.log && echo 'FIS models execution completed'
